context: L6 scale lookup, second review after fixing the three findings of maibo_tests/27b0cd8cd13e1549.json: (1) consensus seeds are now measured-only and fixed before both passes; (2) an OCR depth is accepted only if depth_cm / n_intervals is within 12% of an admissible tick unit {0.1,0.2,0.25,0.5,1,2} cm, else flagged and left for consensus; (3) cv2.imread None now exits with the file name. Reads reports/scale_final.json per-image fields, re-fuses depth+pitch with the extended unit set, fills Siemens stills via the 5.75 cm footprint, reads the left ruler + 'De NN mm' panel on video frames, writes reports/scale_v2.json. Known accepted gap: 644x1088 layout stays unscaled in this version.

errors.desc: `_ocr_digits()` imports `pytesseract` before the `try`, so an environment without that module crashes on the first OCR path instead of falling back to `""` as intended
errors.fix: move the import inside the `try` block or catch `ImportError` explicitly.

errors.desc: `--only` is declared with `nargs="*"` and the filter uses `not a.only`, so invoking `--only` with no image IDs silently processes the full dataset instead of rejecting bad CLI usage
errors.fix: change this to `nargs="+"` or raise an error when `a.only == []`.

errors.desc: loading `reports/scale_final.json` is unguarded, so a missing, unreadable, or malformed input file raises a raw exception on an obvious failure path the script otherwise tries to handle cleanly
errors.fix: wrap the read/parse in `try/except` and exit with a controlled message naming the path.
